title: dovi_tool RPU and hdr10plus_tool JSON injected into an x265 10-bit HEVC stream and read back
summary: ffmpeg makes a 48-frame 640x360 10-bit HEVC stream with PQ/BT.2020 signalling; dovi_tool generates and injects a profile 8.1 RPU from a hand-written config; hdr10plus_tool injects a hand-written HDR10+ JSON into a second copy; both are read back and checked against predeclared values.
